description: This file defines Express.js routes for message-related API endpoints, including fetching user messages, retrieving a single message, toggling read status, and deleting messages.

methods.name: getMyMessages
methods.description: Handles retrieving the list of messages for the current user.

methods.name: getSingle
methods.description: Handles retrieving a single message by ID.

methods.name: toggleRead
methods.description: Handles toggling the read/unread status of a message.
